import z3
import itertools
import time
start = time.time()
vertices = list(range(25))
possible_edges = [(i, j) for i in vertices for j in range(i+1, 25)]
edge_vars = {(i,j): z3.Bool(f'e_{i}_{j}') for i,j in possible_edges}
solver = z3.Solver()
# Degree constraints
for v in vertices:
    incident = [edge_vars[(min(v, w), max(v, w))] for w in vertices if w != v]
    solver.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(e, 1, 0) for e in incident]) >= 3)
    solver.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(e, 1, 0) for e in incident]) <= 4)
# No C3
for i, j, k in itertools.combinations(vertices, 3):
    eij = edge_vars[(i, j)]
    ejk = edge_vars[(j, k)]
    eki = edge_vars[(i, k)]
    solver.add(z3.Or(z3.Not(eij), z3.Not(ejk), z3.Not(eki)))
# No C4
for a, b, c, d in itertools.combinations(vertices, 4):
    # Cycle a-b-c-d-a
    solver.add(z3.Or(z3.Not(edge_vars[(a,b)]), z3.Not(edge_vars[(b,c)]), z3.Not(edge_vars[(c,d)]), z3.Not(edge_vars[(a,d)])))
    # Cycle a-b-d-c-a
    solver.add(z3.Or(z3.Not(edge_vars[(a,b)]), z3.Not(edge_vars[(b,d)]), z3.Not(edge_vars[(c,d)]), z3.Not(edge_vars[(a,c)])))
    # Cycle a-c-b-d-a
    solver.add(z3.Or(z3.Not(edge_vars[(a,c)]), z3.Not(edge_vars[(b,c)]), z3.Not(edge_vars[(b,d)]), z3.Not(edge_vars[(a,d)])))
print("Added C3 and C4 constraints, time:", time.time()-start)
# No C5
count = 0
for comb in itertools.combinations(vertices, 5):
    minv = min(comb)
    for perm_t in itertools.permutations([x for x in comb if x != minv]):
        perm = (minv,) + perm_t
        if perm[1] > perm[-1]: continue
        edges = [edge_vars[(min(perm[i], perm[(i+1)%5]), max(perm[i], perm[(i+1)%5])) for i in range(5)]
        solver.add(z3.Or([z3.Not(e) for e in edges]))
        count += 1
print("Added", count, "C5 constraints, time:", time.time()-start)
status = solver.check()
print(status)
print("Total time:", time.time()-start)

import z3
import itertools
import time
start = time.time()
vertices = list(range(25))
possible_edges = [(i, j) for i in vertices for j in range(i+1, 25)]
edge_vars = {(i,j): z3.Bool(f'e_{i}_{j}') for i,j in possible_edges}
solver = z3.Solver()
# Degree constraints
for v in vertices:
    incident = [edge_vars[(min(v, w), max(v, w))] for w in vertices if w != v]
    solver.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(e, 1, 0) for e in incident]) >= 3)
    solver.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(e, 1, 0) for e in incident]) <= 4)
# No C3
for i, j, k in itertools.combinations(vertices, 3):
    eij = edge_vars[(min(i,j), max(i,j))]
    ejk = edge_vars[(min(j,k), max(j,k))]
    eki = edge_vars[(min(i,k), max(i,k))]
    solver.add(z3.Or(z3.Not(eij), z3.Not(ejk), z3.Not(eki)))
print("Added C3 constraints, time:", time.time()-start)
# No C4
for a, b, c, d in itertools.combinations(vertices, 4):
    ab = edge_vars[(min(a,b), max(a,b))]
    ac = edge_vars[(min(a,c), max(a,c))]
    ad = edge_vars[(min(a,d), max(a,d))]
    bc = edge_vars[(min(b,c), max(b,c))]
    bd = edge_vars[(min(b,d), max(b,d))]
    cd = edge_vars[(min(c,d), max(c,d))]
    # a-b-c-d-a
    solver.add(z3.Or(z3.Not(ab), z3.Not(bc), z3.Not(cd), z3.Not(ad)))
    # a-b-d-c-a
    solver.add(z3.Or(z3.Not(ab), z3.Not(bd), z3.Not(cd), z3.Not(ac)))
    # a-c-b-d-a
    solver.add(z3.Or(z3.Not(ac), z3.Not(bc), z3.Not(bd), z3.Not(ad)))
print("Added C4 constraints, time:", time.time()-start)
# No C5
count = 0
for comb in itertools.combinations(vertices, 5):
    perms = list(itertools.permutations(comb))
    added = set()
    for p in perms:
        cycle = tuple(sorted([tuple(sorted([p[i], p[(i+1)%5]])) for i in range(5)]))
        if cycle in added: continue
        added.add(cycle)
        edges = [edge_vars[(min(p[i], p[(i+1)%5]), max(p[i], p[(i+1)%5])) for i in range(5)]
        solver.add(z3.Or([z3.Not(e) for e in edges]))
        count += 1
        break  # one per unique cycle
print("Added", count, "C5 constraints, time:", time.time()-start)
status = solver.check()
print(status)
print("Total time:", time.time()-start)
